title: Fix Engine Mcp App Csp Eval Violation From Zod Jit
description: The MCP app at ui://semio/design-viewer is broken because Zod v4 (dependency of @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps) uses `new Function()` for JIT compilation, which violates CSP script-src policy. Need to disable Zod JIT or replace it at build time.
